name: Orbit Photo Director
install: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; fi; (cd frontend && bun install --frozen-lockfile); (cd worker && bun install --frozen-lockfile); python3 -m pip install --user -e ".[dev]"'

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd frontend && bun run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 43147'
terminals.description: SNAP Vite dev server at http://127.0.0.1:43147
